texts.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内发现了一只岩居兽。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将其指定为危险害兽之后，成员国有法律义务立即处决在边界内的所有岩居兽。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直到岩居兽离开我们的星系或被消灭为止。
texts.en:
A Cutholoid has been discovered in the [from.GetName] system. Following their designation as a dangerous pest, all [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Cutholoids present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Cutholoid has been exterminated or otherwise driven from our systems.
